protocol.name: owned-severity-intent-controls-v1
protocol.project_delta: Only the declared copied class tuning_profile for the two profile cases; every other project value and original severity/floor remains unchanged.
protocol.default_probe: Loaded Default-only profile intent must be witnessed; finding present or omitted is recorded. Completion does not qualify Default-provider enforcement.
protocol.negative_predicates: Exact target type/severity/UUIDs (profile is global/no UUID); no other blocking, critical, unknown findings or exclusions. All raw findings preserved.
protocol.parity_limit: Exact CLI omits --schematic-parity; copied original schematic does not match newly authored fixture. Empty parity list never establishes coverage.
protocol.machining_limit: Only front counterbore PTH recipe; exact native mode/size/depth/affected layer and targeted track+pad error required. Failure preserved; via/backdrill and countersink unsupported.
